card.name: Characters just after an opening parenthesis
card.fires_on: The first character or digit right after an opening bracket or inside a parenthetical, such as a digit in a percentage or needle size, a step letter, or R/S before enantiomer.

modes.label: Digits in parentheses
modes.description: A number begins or continues inside a bracketed percentage or equipment size.

modes.label: R/S enantiomer letters
modes.description: The letter R or S naming a mirror-image form of a drug.
modes.example: armodafinil, the<< R>> enantiomer of modafinil

modes.label: Step letters
modes.description: A lettered step reference inside parentheses in instructions.
